title: Who Gets to Do Physics? Occupational Stereotypes in AI-Generated Problem Sets

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual occupation substitution in prompts, where models generated physics problems using identical instructions with only the persona changed (e.g., CEO, Physicist, Nurse, Migrant Worker), followed by rubric-based coding of hazard presence, agency, cognitive role, and object ownership.

Evaluating the narrative framing of generated problems to measure disparities in social status, labor, and expertise representations, specifically analyzing the distribution of hazardous scenarios, passive-accident framing, and exclusive possessive ownership language across different class-associated personas.
